description: Fork of exp523 (qk nap=4/tph=256 hard + hard v-branch). ONLY change: reshape v_lut to WIDE-SHALLOW nap 6->4, tph 320->1024 (2^nap*tph: 64*320=20480 -> 16*1024=16384; v_lut params 1.97M->1.57M, -0.4M). Motivation: nap=4 was the wide-shallow sweet spot for qk; test whether the dedicated v_lut also prefers it, and now both v_lut and the v-branch share nap=4 granularity. vs exp523 1.4901 (v_lut nap6/tph320), exp513 1.4825 (no v-branch).
